select o.order_id,o.guaranteed_date,o.created_at,o.channel,o.carrier_id,s.status latest_scan_status,s.event_at latest_event_at,s.ingested_at latest_ingested_at,
cast(julianday(substr(:now,1,10))-julianday(o.guaranteed_date) as int) calendar_late_days,
(select count(*) from delivery_attempts a where a.order_id=o.order_id and a.attempt_at<=:now) visible_attempts,
(select count(*) from delivery_attempts a where a.order_id=o.order_id and a.attempt_at<=:now and a.reason_code='customer_unreachable' and a.call_attempts=0) unreachable_no_calls,
(select count(*) from delivery_attempts a where a.order_id=o.order_id and a.attempt_at<=:now and a.reason_code in ('customer_unreachable','customer_refused','reschedule_requested','wrong_address') and a.call_attempts>=3) customer_reason_three_calls,
(select group_concat(distinct kind) from compensation_ledger l where l.order_id=o.order_id and l.created_at<=:now) historical_kinds
from visible o left join latest s on s.order_id=o.order_id and s.rn=1 where exists(select 1 from delivery_attempts a where a.order_id=o.order_id and a.attempt_at<=:now and a.reason_code in ('customer_unreachable','customer_refused','reschedule_requested','wrong_address') and a.call_attempts>=3) order by o.order_id limit 8

hidden_scan_candidates.sql: select event_id,order_id,status,event_at,ingested_at,(julianday(ingested_at)-julianday(event_at))*86400 lag_s from scan_events where event_at<=? and ingested_at>? order by ingested_at desc limit 8

force_majeure_link_candidates.sql: select distinct s.order_id,s.event_id,s.event_at,s.ingested_at,r.trip_id,r.report_id,r.reason_code,r.reported_at,r.gps_delay_min from scan_events s join linehaul_reports r on s.location_type='trip' and s.location_id=r.trip_id where r.reason_code in ('weather','route_closure') and s.ingested_at<=? and r.reported_at<=? order by s.order_id limit 8
